anchor_desc: Builder call that registers the max_fps setting with value 144, amid sibling .set() calls.

cases.name: unrelated_line_changed
cases.note: Edits an unrelated line in build(); the anchored builder call stays byte-identical.

cases.name: lines_inserted_above
cases.note: Inserts new lines above the anchor; it shifts down but its text is identical.

cases.name: whitespace_change
cases.note: Only internal whitespace before the argument changes on the anchored line.

cases.name: trailing_punct_added
cases.note: Splits the call across lines and adds a trailing comma; relocation lands on the call head.

cases.name: method_renamed
cases.note: Renames the `set` builder method (decl + all call sites); the anchored line keeps its arguments.

cases.name: rename_and_ops_changed
cases.note: Renames the method and changes the numeric operand on the same line: a Type-3 near-miss.

cases.name: anchor_line_deleted
cases.note: Deletes the anchored line; remaining sibling .set() calls differ and must not be matched.

cases.name: boilerplate_trap
cases.note: Deletes the anchor while adding more near-identical .set() calls that could lure a wrong match.

cases.name: anchor_reordered
cases.note: Reorders sibling builder calls; the anchored line moves up but is byte-identical.

cases.name: function_moved
cases.note: Moves the entire defaults() method below build(); the anchored line is byte-identical at a new location.
